Q9024.reason: If the arrest was lawful and the jury believes the suspect's account, the officer used excessive force first, so the suspect could use reasonable self-defense; the team note that an unlawful arrest removes all privilege to use force is wrong, since a person may use reasonable force against excessive force even then.

Q9025.reason: Under Prah v. Maretti, unreasonably blocking a neighbor's sunlight can be a private nuisance even if the building complies with zoning, especially when a less harmful placement exists, so the team note's presumption in favor of lawful use is not the rule.

Q9027.reason: Civil law defines rights between persons and gives redress for violations, while stare decisis is just the doctrine of following precedent.
